body:
Server Info: https://avicus.net/forums/2b210ed35

Date & Time: Friday, March 25th / 2:00PM EST

Scenarios:
Slave Market: Pre-game, bidders are randomly chosen and given a stack of diamond. With these diamonds the bidders will buy "slaves" (the other people who weren't chosen to be bidders). The bidders can buy as many slaves as they want. Left over diamonds can be used in the match.

Voidscape: All stone and bedrock is set to air.

Information left empty will soon be updated and this thread will be bumped indicating that it has been updated. I will usually do this early posting on some occasions so you may leave free time during indicated days to play
